Adapted upper bridge tile ranges, chance coefficients, ore tier order,
machine batch lifecycle, repair chance, relative costs and structure.

last inventory overfill, lower1/3depletion, upper15–27sec, coal cleaning XP0,
nugget7/256 with five historic8/256levels. Not a wholesale module import.
References verified: OSRS Wiki Motherlode_Mine, Ore_vein, Golden_nugget,
Coal_bag, Bag_full_of_gems. See REVISAO-V11.txt for known limits.
